properties.project_name: Mission Hall (Global Health & Clinical Sciences Building)
properties.digitized_from: OpenStreetMap (way 255652151, official_name=Global Health & Clinical Sciences Building, 500 16th St)
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF campus pass: real OSM building footprint.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 at 675 Nelson Rising Lane alone is ~13 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.
properties.notes: Consolidates ~1,500 UCSF global health faculty/staff/students plus the Office of the Chancellor in one seven-story, 266,000 sq ft building. Architect WRNS Studio (design-builder Rudolph and Sletten; landscape Andrea Cochran Landscape Architecture). Opened for occupancy September 2014, ribbon-cutting October 2014. Address note: this project's geometry is tagged 500 16th St from OpenStreetMap's own addr:housenumber, but every other source found (UCSF's own press release, the architect's project page) gives 550 16th St -- flagging the discrepancy rather than silently picking one.
